title: Reviewer Decision Email Pack
purpose: Turn meeting minutes, reply states, review gates, and archive rules into targeted reviewer follow-up emails before the private backend repo closeout.

sourceReadiness.readiness: Owner actions and decision rows feed reviewer emails.
Reply states decide the email template.
Archive and redaction rules shape closeout language.
Reviewer gates define approval, hold, block, and merge-ready conditions.

reviewerLanes.emailIntent: Approve, hold, defer, or reject alpha scope and management wording.
Confirm private repo, branch protection, required checks, protected environments, and rollback.
Confirm route shell, migrations, tests, command proof, unresolved holds, and next commit path.
Confirm tenant guard, no-secret, no-workbook, commercial redaction, and denied audit proof.
Confirm seed boundary, import dry-run, quarantine, duplicate handling, rollback, and reconciliation.
Confirm screenshots, transcripts, signoffs, issue URLs, PR notes, and archive naming.
Confirm test-mode billing, no invoice, no payment key, and no billing export.
Confirm minutes, decision register, open actions, follow-up cadence, and management email.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: Reviewer lane needs a clear approve/comment/hold/request-changes state.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Confirm evidence linked, no-leak statement accepted, and next owner clear.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: A hold exists without enough proof.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Confirm missing proof, owner, target date, and next command.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: A blocker stops merge or closeout.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Confirm blocker, trust failure, required fix, evidence needed, and no-merge condition.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: Evidence can arrive later but needs formal ownership.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Confirm reason for deferral, owner, date, expected artifact, and review checkpoint.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: Reviewer did not reply after minutes are published.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Reply with approve, comment, hold, request changes, defer proof, block, or no-go.
Confirm gates, evidence, redaction, rollback, and owner actions are closed.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: Sponsor needs a clean decision note.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Review decision summary and owner queue before the sponsor note is sent.

decisionEmailTemplates.useWhen: Closeout packet needs distribution and retention signoff.
decisionEmailTemplates.coreAsk: Confirm filename, distribution, redaction, PR placeholder, owner, and retention rules.

copyReadyReviewerEmailLines: Please confirm your decision for the {lane} lane on the private backend repo review.
Requested reply state: Approve / Comment / Hold / Request changes / Defer proof / Block / No response / Merge-ready
No-leak statement: no workbook, production secret, payment key, invoice, billing export, or commercial tracker value is included in this request unless separately authorized.
Please reply with the exact state and any required evidence or blocker.
copyReadyEscalationEmailLines: Subject: PursuitDesk decision follow-up - open reviewer state
This reviewer lane still needs a decision before closeout can move forward.
Please update the reply capture board or confirm whether this should become deferred proof, requested changes, blocked, or approved.
acceptanceChecks: Reviewer lanes cover sponsor, platform, backend, security, data, QA, billing, and scribe.
Templates cover approval, hold, requested changes, deferral, no response, merge, summary, and archive.
Triggers decide which email is sent.
Send checklist prevents vague or unsafe emails.
Escalation cadence prevents silence after minutes.
Privacy guardrails prevent data leakage in reviewer emails.
Management summary explains the email posture.
Next handoff can track archive state and unresolved reply evidence gaps.
handoff: v146 turns minutes, reply states, and review gates into targeted reviewer decision emails.
The pack separates approval requests, holds, requested changes, deferred proof, no-response chases, merge confirmation, management summary, and archive approval.
The static demo cannot send email or capture replies automatically; it defines the templates, triggers, privacy guardrails, and audit fields the backend must implement.
v147 can track which closeout packets, archive names, replies, and evidence gaps remain open after emails are sent.
